verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a way for external CI services to report build results as status checks on GitLab commits or merge requests, such as a commit status API or an external pipeline status display. The material available is generic REST API mentions, GitLab's own CI/CD, security findings shown in merge requests, and partner integrations such as env0 running Terraform Plan on merge requests; none of these is the named capability. A community note that services like TravisCI generally don't integrate with GitLab further suggests external CI reporting was not well supported, though it does not prove absence.

support.subject: As a developer, I can see builds from external CI services reported as status checks on commits and pull requests
